newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rupee quoted at near record levels.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rupee quoted at near record levels.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee was quoted at near-record levels but there was no trading in the first two hours as dealers waited for direction, dealers said on Friday.
The rupee was quoted 56.94 to the dollar at 0330 GMT, the same rate quoted at the opening. It ended at a new closing record of 56.95 on Thursday.
"Bids are at 56.94 and offers are at 57 rupees to the dollar. The market is cautious because jumping a big figure is a jittery business," said a Citibank dealer.
Dollar movement will be tight "unless an extraordinary import bill or inward remittance comes in," he said.
The Central Bank left the dollar-rupee exchange rate unchanged, which left the market guessing, dealers said. The central bank's buying and selling rates were 55.9226 and 57.0524 respectively.
The overnight call money rate stood at 16.5 percent after closing at 13.5 on Thursday as a nubmer of big borrwers emerged on the market, dealers said.
